description: Machine-readable lock of every numeric pre-registered threshold in the WASC spec. Each entry pairs a spec_reference (file + line + verbatim quote) with a code_default location (file + symbol + value). tests/wasc/test_locked_bounds.py verifies (a) the spec_quote appears in the cited file and (b) the code_default value matches the runtime default. Drift in either side fails CI.

E_WASC_total.description: Pre-registered count of WASC edges (Splicing 434 + Chromatin 443 + Transport 67, with 40 cross-theme dupes counted under each theme).

permutation_B_primary.description: B for the primary M3 run. v1.0.3 freeze.

permutation_B_sensitivity.description: B floor for sensitivity runs. v1.0.3 freeze (table at decision-log).

permutation_B_floor_tie_rerun.description: B for the floor-tie tertiary rerun. Per v1.0.4 audit: this is currently CONTINGENT on floor-tie detection per spec, but the arithmetic correction in v1.0.4 (C1) shows that at B=9999 ranks 1..7 are untestable for BY q<=0.10. Whether to PROMOTE this to primary is a v1.1 question (not in v1.0.4 scope).

min_n_per_group_C9.description: Minimum complete-case donor count per group for FWL convergence. C9 floor.

spec_reference.search_quote: `|S_{j, a, g}| ≥ 10` for C9 and `|S_{j, a, g}| ≥ 15` for SPOR/CTRL

min_valid_perms_default.description: Per-edge floor of finite null draws for p-value computation. Spec C2 floor = 48 (spec §4 line 199).

min_unique_q_values_default.description: Per-edge floor of DISTINCT finite null Q values. Defensive correctness guard for constant-Q_null pathology (commit 43e5aba). Not a primary spec value; pre-registered K=5 in commit message; inert at all-protein-pool substrate.

max_relaxation_default.description: Sampler ±1-decile fallback default. Spec §4 v1.0.2: '±1 decile fallback on |r|'.

axes_default.description: Default cell-key axes per v1.0.2 amendment (missingness dropped). 2-axis (degree, |Pearson|) matched.

prong_b_jaccard_floor.description: M2.5 prong (b) DoD: down-sampled-SPOR-to-25 overlap with full-N WASC-positive set >= 70%. Per build plan §5 lines 25, 766. This is a SPEC value, not a code default. As of v1.0.3 substrate the observed Jaccard at raw p<0.10 was 0.285 (HARD FAIL). v1.0.4 corrects no rescue path; the FAIL remains binding.

spec_reference.search_quote: Down-sampled-SPOR-to-25 overlap with full-N WASC-positive set

prong_d_FW_vs_OLS_tolerance.description: M2.5 prong (d) DoD: F-W ≡ statsmodels.OLS on production design, absolute tolerance 1e-8 on β and SE. Per spec §2.5(a) line 150 + build plan §5 line 27, line 768. Observed at v1.0.3: β abs 2.39e-10, SE rel 3.14e-10 — both PASS with 30-40× margin.

canonical_direction_lex_order.description: WascEdge canonical direction: anchor = lex-smaller endpoint. Build plan §3: 'edge_id = f"{min(a, j)}|{max(a, j)}"'. M2.2 EdgeBetaTable fits each edge ONCE in canonical direction; per-anchor null/Brown must match. Fix applied commit f1081ba.

canonical_anchor_count.description: Distinct UniProts appearing as canonical anchor in E_WASC. Per-(anchor,theme) work units = 220 (17 multi-theme anchors get one unit per theme). v1.0.4 C16 correction: prior spec text used 'order 220-280' loosely; verified 203 from data/wasc/E_WASC_v1.json.
